postings.title: OTA Validation Engineer
top_requirements: Design and execute OTA test plans for multiple cellular technologies, translating carrier specifications into measurable test cases.
Perform hands‑on radiated system characterization, including spectrum analysis, EVM, and link‑budget validation at test stations.
Develop and maintain automated test scripts and data‑analysis tools to ensure repeatable performance verification.
bonus_skills: RF test equipment (e.g., VNA, spectrum analyzer)
postings.summary: The role focuses on OTA validation of wireless products, requiring deep RF test expertise. It suits the candidate’s hands‑on RF and communications background while offering senior‑level responsibility.

postings.title: E2E Test Automation Engineer — Wireless Systems & Devices
top_requirements: Develop and validate end‑to‑end LEO satellite communication links, including RF front‑end and baseband modem integration.
Create and run automated test suites for hardware‑in‑the‑loop verification of IoT connectivity performance.
Lead hardware bring‑up and characterization of RF subsystems for mass‑production readiness.
postings.summary: A hands‑on systems role building a LEO IoT satellite network, matching the candidate’s satellite communications experience while moving toward broader RF system design.

postings.title: Senior Wireless RF Systems Engineer
top_requirements: Lead board‑level RF schematic capture and layout for multi‑band wireless products, ensuring compliance with FCC and industry specs.
Perform full RF chain validation, including S‑parameter, noise figure, IIP3, and EVM measurements across prototypes and production units.
Drive antenna‑integration strategies and system‑level simulations to optimize link performance for large‑scale deployments.
postings.summary: Senior RF Systems Engineer responsible for complete RF hardware development, aligning with the candidate’s RF design and test expertise.

postings.title: Senior 6G Wireless Systems Engineer - Prototyping
top_requirements: Design, prototype, and validate 6G RF front‑end and baseband blocks, including DSP algorithms for ultra‑wideband operation.
Lead hardware‑in‑the‑loop testing of prototype boards, performing over‑the‑air measurements and link‑budget analysis.
Collaborate with academic and industry partners to demonstrate proof‑of‑concept performance against emerging 6G standards.
postings.summary: Prototyping 6G wireless systems in Singapore, providing hands‑on RF/DSP work that aligns with the candidate’s desire to move beyond aerospace into cutting‑edge communications.

postings.title: Automotive Wireless Systems Engineer: Connected Cockpit & 5G
top_requirements: Develop end‑to‑end wireless communication stacks for automotive 5G and Bluetooth, from PHY to application layer.
Perform RF system integration and validation on automotive‑grade hardware, ensuring compliance with automotive reliability standards.
Create automated test benches for over‑the‑air performance and coexistence testing in vehicle environments.
postings.summary: Automotive wireless systems engineer working on connected cockpit technologies, offering a shift from space to automotive while using the candidate’s RF and modem skills.

postings.title: Sr. RF DVT Engineer, Amazon Leo Silicon
top_requirements: Lead RF DVT activities for low‑Earth‑orbit satellite silicon, including on‑die measurement of gain, noise figure, and linearity across temperature and voltage corners.
Develop and execute automated test flows for high‑volume production validation of RF front‑end blocks.
Collaborate with architecture teams to translate system link‑budget requirements into silicon specifications and test plans.
postings.summary: Senior RF DVT engineer for Amazon Leo, a hands‑on role that directly uses the candidate’s RF test expertise in a high‑pay, senior position.
